solutions.explanation: \(y^2\) equals a positive number times \(x\), so the focus lies on the positive x-axis and the parabola opens to the right.
solutions.title: Use the standard parabola form

solutions.explanation: Rewrite the equation as \(x=y^2/4\). Thus \(x\ge0\), with equality only when \(y=0\), and opposite values of \(y\) give the same \(x\). The vertex is the origin, and as \(|y|\) increases, both branches extend farther in the positive \(x\)-direction. Therefore the parabola opens to the right, choice A.
